how_to_apply: Attend the walk-in interview on the date for your specialization with the duly filled application form in the prescribed format enclosed with the notice.
The application form is available on the website https://www.nal.res.in.
Do not send the application by post, speed post or e-mail.
Apply separately for each position you want to be considered for.
Report between 9.00 AM and 9.30 AM at the venue for registration and verification of documents; no registration after 09.45 AM.
Mention your category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/EWS) clearly and attach documentary proof if claiming age relaxation.
Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.
important_instructions: If the interview is not completed on the indicated day, candidates may have to attend the next day. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. Director, CSIR-NAL may increase or decrease the number of positions or cancel the recruitment at any stage. Queries: 080-25086048 / 22514032; [email protected] A claimed equivalent qualification needs an order/letter showing the authority, number and date, otherwise the application is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.text: Candidates whose qualifying examination results are awaited Candidates who use canvassing or bring influence, political or otherwise, will be disqualified

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments are printed as a fixed amount plus HRA; the HRA amount is not printed. Purely temporary and contract basis, for a short period and co-terminus with the project May be terminated at any time with one month's notice from either side or one-month stipend in lieu Maximum duration in one project or different projects together in CSIR-NAL or other CSIR labs: not more than six years in any case No rights to continuation beyond tenure, absorption or regularization in CSIR Selected candidates should contact the Recruitment Section with original documents within 15 days for reporting date and time

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR-NAL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview; selection based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s) If a large number of candidates appear, the Selection/Screening Committee may shortlist for the interview based on a written exam or any other criteria Panel of suitable candidates, valid for a maximum of one year; empanelment gives no automatic guarantee of engagement Selection is based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s). CSIR-NAL adopts its own criteria for shortlisting; having more than the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called. List of selected candidates will be notified on https://www.nal.res.in, with a waiting list panel valid for one year.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copy of Aadhar Card or any Government-issued ID card with photograph Duly filled application form Latest passport size photograph Original certificates with one set of photocopies, including Caste Certificate if any Documentary proof of category for age relaxation No Objection Certificate from Project Leader/HOD, if working in CSIR-NAL or any other CSIR lab

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on the date for your specialization with the duly filled application form in the prescribed format enclosed with the notice. The application form is available on the website https://www.nal.res.in. Do not send the application by post, speed post or e-mail. Apply separately for each position you want to be considered for. Report between 9.00 AM and 9.30 AM at the venue for registration and verification of documents; no registration after 09.45 AM. Mention your category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/EWS) clearly and attach documentary proof if claiming age relaxation. Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 46 vacancies: 12 Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical, 8 Project Associate-II (PAT-II) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical/Thermal Design, 1 Project Assistant-I (PA-I) – Fitter, 1 Senior PAT – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical, 2 Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Metallurgical Engineering/Physics/Materials Science/Chemistry, 1 Project Associate-I (PAT-I) with/without NET/GATE – Metallurgical Engineering/Physics/Materials Science/Chemistry and 7 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR-NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical: maximum 35 years; Project Associate-II (PAT-II) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical/Thermal Design: maximum 35 years; Project Assistant-I (PA-I) – Fitter: maximum 35 years; Senior PAT – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical: maximum 40 years; Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Metallurgical Engineering/Physics/Materials Science/Chemistry: maximum 35 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹25,000 +HRA for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical, ₹28,000 +HRA for Project Associate-II (PAT-II) – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical/Thermal Design, ₹18,000 +HRA for Project Assistant-I (PA-I) – Fitter, ₹42,000 +HRA for Senior PAT – Mechanical/Aerospace/Aeronautical, ₹25,000 +HRA for Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – Metallurgical Engineering/Physics/Materials Science/Chemistry.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SSC/10th plus ITI (Fitter) for PA-I; B.Sc or 3 years Diploma in Engg/Tech for PA-II; Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (with 2 or 3 years' R&D experience for PAT-II and Senior PAT, or Masters/Integrated Masters) for the other posts. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals may apply. Qualification and age are determined as on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose qualifying examination results are awaited. Candidates who use canvassing or bring influence, political or otherwise, will be disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview; selection based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s). If a large number of candidates appear, the Selection/Screening Committee may shortlist for the interview based on a written exam or any other criteria. Panel of suitable candidates, valid for a maximum of one year; empanelment gives no automatic guarantee of engagement. Selection is based on performance in the interview or any other criteria adopted by the selection committee(s).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and contract basis, for a short period and co-terminus with the project. May be terminated at any time with one month's notice from either side or one-month stipend in lieu. Maximum duration in one project or different projects together in CSIR-NAL or other CSIR labs: not more than six years in any case.
